dedupe_keys.name: resource demands and node availability in a telco data centre intracom telecom and athena rc

description: Researchers of the Athena Research and Innovation Center and Intracom Telecom in Greece publish a dataset of application demands in telecommunication cloud data centres, where network functions and services run as containers. It records pod resource requests over time for three workload types, dynamic, static and a hybrid mix, and the allocatable capacity of the cluster nodes over time; in the underlying experiments machine learning models forecast resource demand and decision algorithms chose how many nodes to keep active to match the expected pod demand. Coverage: an experimental telco cloud environment in Greece; the period is not stated in the record. Format and access: three compressed CSV files (about 0.73 GB) on Zenodo, free of charge under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: workloads are generated in a testbed that reproduces production patterns, not logged from a live operator; no energy or location data. Simulation uses: demand and capacity time series for scaling, capacity planning and energy-aware operation of telecom cloud infrastructure, and for testing how it copes with load surges. Related records: the Google, Alibaba and Azure cluster traces cover general cloud workloads; the Slovak RAN counters show radio network load.
